feed_summary: When an MDR provider contains a compromised endpoint, your team needs to know whether the weakness that enabled the attack exists elsewhere and who is responsible for addressing it. Without that follow-through, the immediate incident may be resolved while another attacker still has a way in. Preemptive managed detection and response (MDR) is Rapid7's approach to connecting exposure context, threat intelligence, AI-assisted investigation, and human expertise. It supports proactive cybersecurity by helping teams prioritize weaknesses before exploitation, investigate threats with a clearer understanding of risk, and use their findings to strengthen defenses.
